name: A Place in the Sun
description: The programme that helps house-hunters find their dream holiday home in the sun.

videos.title: Brisbane, Australia
videos.overview: Kevin and Jackie Arkell want to retire to Australia. They discover that their £100,000 budget can buy them a luxury town house in a seaside resort, a brand new designer home, a traditional Queenslander house on stilts and a custom built house by the beach for £56,500. They also find out how easy it is to get a visa to live in Australia.

Jean shows them five properties within their budget of £200,000 but will any of them be their dream home?

videos.title: Corrèze, France
videos.overview: Danni Menzies heads to France’s Corrèze region to help Alan and Joe find the perfect holiday home. For their budget of £60,000, they’re looking for a property in or around the town of pretty, medieval town of Treignac. Danni has five impressive properties up her sleeve but will any of them be dream place for Alan and Joe?

videos.title: Tenerife, Spain
videos.overview: Ambulance dispatcher Helen and builder Andrew from Yorkshire are looking to buy a holiday home for all the family to enjoy in their favourite part of the island-Los Gigantes in Tenerife. They have a budget of £130,000 and dream of a two bedroom apartment with outside space. Lee Juggurnauth has 5 great properties lined up-will any of them impress?

videos.title: Costa Da Caparica, Portugal
videos.overview: Laura Hamilton is on Portugal's beautiful Costa Da Caparica helping Caron and Ivo find a holiday home that might become permanent. Can they find space for Ivo's bikes and Caron's clothes?

videos.title: Malaga, Spain
videos.overview: Farmers David and Debbie from Lincolnshire are looking for a holiday home in and around the town of Coin in Spain’s Malaga Province. They’re looking a for place big enough to house their pet horse Woody and their five children. They have a budget of £230,000 and Danni Menzies has 5 great properties but will she find the perfect property for all the family?

videos.title: Oliva, Spain
videos.overview: Debbie and Graham want to find their very own holiday home in the beautiful town of Oliva, in the south of Spain's Valencia region. Can Sara Damergi find the perfect place for their £80k budget?

videos.title: Bergerac, France
videos.overview: Gill and Rhys love the charm of the Dordogne countryside so much that a permanent move is on the cards. Craig Rowe shows them what £190k can buy in Bergerac, but will any of his options hit the mark?

videos.title: Southern Costa Blanca
videos.overview: Leah Charles-King helps Julie and Leo find the perfect holiday home on the southern Costa Blanca for all three generations of their family to enjoy. How far can their £120k budget stretch?

videos.title: Eastern Peloponnese
videos.overview: Lee Juggurnauth is jetting off to the Greek island of Aegina to help Marjory find the perfect holiday home that all the family can enjoy. She’s chosen this island as its just a ferry ride from her son and baby grandson who live in the Greek capital Athens. To help her in her search, she’s brought along her twin sister Margaret, who plans to be spending plenty of time in the property too. With a budget of £150,000 Lee has 5 great options lined up, but will Marjory love any enough to put in an offer?

videos.title: Malaga Province
videos.overview: Suzie and Ram dream of owning a holiday home on Spain's popular Costa del Sol. With Ram unable to join the search, Laura Hamilton shows Suzie and her son Rishi what £250k can buy.

videos.title: Fuerteventura, Spain
videos.overview: Jasmine Harman is house hunting around the east coast of Fuerteventura in the Canary Islands, with Steve and his wife Sid. They both have busy lives and can’t wait to buy their own holiday home where they can escape for relaxing getaways with their family. The couple have a budget of £100,000 and are looking for a 2-bedroom property with a communal pool. Jasmine has 5 fantastic options up her sleeve, but will any match up to their dreams?

videos.title: Haute-Vienne, France
videos.overview: Jean Johansson is in south west France, helping Gary and keen photographer Jan find their dream holiday home in the beautiful countryside of Haute-Vienne, where they can spend several months of the year enjoying the great outdoors with both their families. The couple have a budget of £140,000 to buy a house that’s ideally detached, with lots of outside space and a pool. Jean has lined them up 5 great properties, but after they’ve seen them all-will any be in the frame?

videos.title: Costa Cálida, Spain
videos.overview: Ben Hillman helps Joan and Andrew find their dream holiday home on Spain's Costa Cálida for the whole family to enjoy. With a budget of £80k, can they find the perfect place?

videos.title: Setúbal Peninsula, Portugal
videos.overview: Tony and Hendrik hunt for their dream holiday home on Portugal's Setúbal Peninsula for £330k. Can Danni Menzies find the perfect place for all their family to enjoy?

videos.title: Mijas Costa, Spain
videos.overview: Laura Hamilton helps sisters Sheila and Jean look for a holiday home on Spain's Mijas Costa for all their family and friends to enjoy for £120k. Will they find their dream place?

videos.title: Pinar de Campoverde, Spain
videos.overview: It's full steam ahead for train driver Wayne and train manager Kate, as Lee Juggurnauth shows them the best of what their £85k budget can get them in the town of Pinar de Campoverde in Spain

videos.title: Lagos, Algarve, Portugal
videos.overview: Vicky and Tom are taking early retirement and making a permanent move to the coastal town of Lagos on Portugal's Algarve. Can Laura Hamilton find their perfect place for £235k?

videos.title: South West Tenerife
videos.overview: Danni Menzies helps John and Carol look for a holiday home on the Canary Island of Tenerife. With a budget of £120k, can they find their dream place - and will they put in an offer?

videos.title: Crete, Greece
videos.overview: Semi-retired NHS worker Tara is longing to buy a holiday home for her and her family and friends to enjoy on the beautiful Greek island of Crete. Ben Hillman shows her what £90k can buy.

videos.title: Inland Valencia, Spain
videos.overview: Jasmine Harman helps Caroline and Gary with their dream of owning a Spanish holiday home. What will Valencia province's countryside and villages offer for their £150k?

videos.title: Lecrin Valley, Granada, Spain
videos.overview: Laura Hamilton steps up to the challenge of helping Helyn and Kamil from Brighton find their perfect holiday home in and around the beautiful Lecrin Valley in Granada Province. They want a bolthole in the sun where they can relax and unwind whenever they like, and one day make their permanent home. They have a budget of £200,000 and Laura has lined up 5 great options, but will they love any enough to put in an offer?

videos.title: Corfu, Greece
videos.overview: Danni Menzies heads to the Greek island of Corfu to help catering business owner Sarah from Manchester find her dream holiday home. Joining her is Jo who she’s been best friends with since their schooldays. With a budget of £170,000 Danni shows them five stunning properties but will any of them be perfect?

videos.title: Costa Almería, Spain
videos.overview: Andy and Elina look for their dream holiday home on Spain's Costa Almería, for their £85k.

videos.title: Dordogne, France
videos.overview: Diane and Nigel dream of owning their own place in France's Dordogne region. Can Lee Juggurnauth find their perfect holiday home for their £180k budget?

videos.title: Inland Valencia, Spain
videos.overview: Leah Charles-King helps James and Laura find a permanent home in the Valencian countryside.

videos.title: Benalmádena, Spain
videos.overview: Leah Charles-King is coming to the help of account manager Helen and engineer Steve who love the seaside town of Benalmadena on Spain’s Costa del Sol. They’re looking for their perfect holiday home that will suit them, their four children and their eight grandchildren. With a budget of £100,000 and 5 impressive properties, can Leah deliver their dream?

videos.title: East Coast Cyprus
videos.overview: Jasmine Harman helps Fiona and David find their perfect holiday home in Cyprus on a budget of £100,000. As a former Royal Navy engineer who used to be based in Cyprus, David knows the island well but Jasmine hopes she can find them the ideal spot.

videos.title: Maspalomas, Gran Canaria
videos.overview: B&B owners Andy and Julian enlist the help of Laura Hamilton in finding their dream home away from home in Gran Canaria on a budget of £125,000.

videos.title: Kefalonia, Greece
videos.overview: Ben Hillman jets off to Kefalonia in Greece to help Jenny find the perfect holiday home for her family. Helping Jenny with this house hunt is her younger brother Richard, who plans to come and stay regularly. For their budget of £250,000 they want a two-bedroom house with plenty of outside space to enjoy the beautiful weather.

videos.title: La Zenia, Spain
videos.overview: Craig Rowe helps recently retired Helen find a holiday home with a pool in La Zenia, Spain. Armed with £105k and best friend Shelley's help, can Helen find the one?
